notes: «وتقاربا في اللفظ» is an editor's gloss and is left out

«وفي رواية سويد» opens two further routes of the same report: Suwayd from Abu al-Salil, and Ubayd Allah b. Sa'id from Yahya («يعني ابن سعيد» is a gloss) from al-Taymi, closed by «بهذا الإسناد» as a back_reference
«أبي هريرة» is the one asked («قلت لأبي هريرة») and answers, so he is the last link
